phone.about.title: Title of the "i" tab on smartphones; {app} = program name.
methwarn.item: Warning above the panels; {method} = name of the .dam, {expects} = experiment type of the method (Full Scan, MS2, MRM), {files} = types of the open files, already joined (e.g. "Full Scan and MRM").
methwarn.and: Joins two experiment names: "Full Scan and MRM".
panel.title.ticMs2: Title of the product TIC chromatogram with a single precursor; {ms} = level (MS², MS³).
panel.title.ticMs2All: Title of the product TIC chromatogram with all precursors; {ms} = level (MS², MS³).
panel.title.ms2prec: Title of the product TIC chromatogram when the file has several precursors and one is chosen; {ms} = level (MS², MS³), {prec} = precursor m/z.
panel.title.kindPrec: Title of a chromatogram (TIC or BPC) restricted to one precursor; {kind} = TIC or BPC, {prec} = m/z.
panel.title.pda: Title of a PDA chromatogram at one wavelength or one range; {nm} = value or range in nm.
panel.title.productOf: Title of the product spectrum of a precursor; {ms} = level (MS², MS³), {prec} = precursor m/z.
panel.title.mrmOne: Title of an MRM panel with a single transition; {tr} = Q1>Q3.
panel.title.simOne: Title of a SIM panel with a single ion; {tr} = its key.
panel.title.composite: Title of the composite spectrum (HR bench); {t0} and {t1} = ends of the RT interval.
panel.title.xicOne: Title of a panel with a single XIC; {label} = its label.
panel.rul.title: The quoted name is the menu entry spec.measure.
hov.rt: Header of the chart hover; {v} = retention time in minutes.
hov.time: Header of the chromatogram hover; {v} = time in minutes.
hov.nm: Header of the hover; {v} = wavelength in nm.
hov.mau: Absorbance value in the hover; {v} = number, unit mAU.
map.hov: Mouse box on the map; {what} = "difference" or "mean intensity".
map.leg.minus: Legend of the difference map; {label} = reference file (escaped).
panel.num.title: Tooltip on the panel number; {n} = number (1-9), it is also the key to press.
panel.rt.held: Retention time label next to the title of a frozen spectrum (not following the cursor); {rt} = already formatted time, e.g. "12.34 min" or "12.30-12.50 min".
panel.pair.to: Tooltip on the "→ n" label of the source chart; {n} = number of the panel (spectrum) that follows it.
panel.scanOf: Label in the header of a chromatogram with several overlaid files that drives a spectrum: {f} = name of the active file, whose scans these are.
map.hov.bin: Mouse box on the 2D map; {lo} and {hi} = ends of the cell in m/z.
map.leg2d.mean: Legend of the 2D map; {scale} = color scale (square root/linear/log).
ms2.nearestScan: Message on the chromatogram; {rt} = retention time of the scan found.
ms2.scanStep: Line below the chromatogram at each step; {i} = sequence number, {tot} = total, {rt} = RT in minutes.
modi.full.q1: The three q1-q3 rows of each mode must start with "Q1 ", "Q2 ", "Q3 " (the table removes the prefix).
of.role.isoP: Role of a co-eluting ion: isotope of the parent P; {k} = how many extra neutrons.
of.role.isoX: Role of a co-eluting ion; X = the ion under study, P = the parent.
of.warn.fewScans: Warning on the origin of an ion; {n} = number of scans in the peak.
pal.d.hr: Row of a high-resolution search result; {d} = signed difference in Da, {ppm} = signed difference in ppm.
pal.formula.mass: Search result for a formula; {m} = neutral mass.
pal.formula.ion: Search result for a formula with an adduct; {adduct} = adduct name, for example [M+Na]+.
pal.more: Last row of the contaminants in the search; {n} = how many more there are.
pal.count: Announcement for screen readers below the field of the command palette; {n} = number of commands found.
lv.sentence: Sentence of the confidence level ({lv} = label of the Schymanski scale: L1, L2a, L2b, L3a, L3b, L4, L5 or L0; {name} = name of the level).
lv.dec.1: Deciding sentence of level 1; {name} = name of the standard.
lv.dec.2a: Deciding sentence of level 2a; {lib} = name of the library (with a leading space, or empty), {name} = name of the candidate.
lv.dec.tetto: Deciding sentence of the unit-resolution profile: all gates passed, but the level does not go beyond the cap; {name} = candidate, {lib} = library, {lv} = maximum level.
lv.dec.3conf: Deciding sentence: the candidate passes the source gates but not the confirmation gates; {gates} = list of the evidence not passed.
lv.dec.3prov: Deciding sentence of provisional level 3; {gates} = list of the evidence not passed.
lv.dec.3susp: Deciding sentence of level 3a from suspect fragments; {n} = listed fragments found in the MS2, {name} = name of the suspect.
lv.dec.3an: Deciding sentence: only an analogue; {cos} = modified cosine, {delta} = signed mass difference.
lv.dec.none: Deciding sentence when no source passes the gates; {name} = closest candidate, {gate} = evidence not passed.
lv.decoyq: Reason row of a library candidate with a decoy q-value; {q} = q-value; always with the note "lower bound", it is not the probability that the identity is right.
lv.refuse.2b: Message when the chemist tries to write 2b where it is not allowed; {lv} = proposed level.
meta.grad.aria: Accessible label of the time color bar. {a} = first time, {b} = last time (with unit).
meta.imported: Message after importing the metadata table. {n} = files updated.
meta.of: Prefix of the accessible label of the fields of the metadata table. {f} = file name.
meta.unknown: Rows of the imported table with no matching open file. {list} = names separated by commas.
pca.off: Message in place of the PCA controls. {min} = minimum number of samples, {n} = samples available.
pca.blank.on: Informational row about the blank filter used by the PCA. {f} = factor, {stat} = maximum/mean, {n} = minimum detections.
pca.steps: Summary of the filters: {t} features in the table, {b} above the blank, {i} above the intensity threshold, {p} present in at least {k} samples, {u} used.
pca.steps.noblank: As above, without the blank step.
pca.imputed: Statement of the imputation. {n} = values replaced.
pca.expl: List of the explained variance. {list} = "PC1 41.2 %, PC2 ...".
pca.scores.aria: Accessible label of the scores chart. {x}, {y} = explained variance of PC1 and PC2.
pca.loadings.aria: Accessible label of the loadings chart. {x}, {y} = explained variance of PC1 and PC2.
pca.axis: Title of an axis. {pc} = PC1/PC2, {v} = explained variance as a percentage.
pca.ell: Description of an ellipse. {g} = name of the replicate group.
pca.row.aria: Accessible label of a row. {mz} = m/z, {rt} = RT.
pfas.plot.aria: Accessible label of the MD/C versus m/C chart. {n} = ions with a candidate formula.
pfas.point.tip: Tooltip on a point of the PFAS chart. {mz} = m/z, {f} = candidate formula, {mdc} = MD/C, {n} = evidence in the MS2.
pfas.progress: Progress of the formula calculation. {n} = ions done, {m} = total ions.
pfas.row.aria: Accessible label of a PFAS row or point. {mz} = m/z, {rt} = RT.
pfas.sum: Summary above the PFAS chart. {n} = ions, {f} = ions with a candidate formula, {e} = ions with at least one piece of evidence in the MS2.
pfas.capped: Below the PFAS summary, only if the table has more ions than the view cap. {m} = ions in the table, {n} = ions examined (the cap), {go} = label of the Calculate button (kmd.go).
pca.sample.tip: Tooltip on a point of the chart. {f} = file, {t} = time.
map.sc.gamma: "gamma" color scale in the map legend; {g} = chosen exponent (number).
mem.more.text: Warning before using more memory in a Tabui (pipeline) stage. {fase} = stage name, {stima_mb} = estimated memory in MB, {budget_mb} = safe budget in MB, {libero_mb} = free MB, {high_mb} = high budget in MB.
mol.edit.aria: Accessible name of the "Edit" button of a row of the Molecules window; {name} = name of the molecule.
mol.delete.aria: Accessible name of the "Delete" button of a row of the Molecules window; {name} = name of the molecule.
mol.delete.confirm: Question before deleting a user molecule; {name} = name of the molecule.
mol.deleted: Announcement after the deletion; {name} = name of the molecule.
mol.saved: Announcement after saving; {name} = name of the molecule.
mol.exported: Announcement after the export; {file} = name of the downloaded file.
mol.cap.mine: Title of the table without a search; {n} = number of user molecules.
mol.cap.results: Title of the table with a search; {n} = number of results.
mol.form.edit: Title of the edit form; {name} = name of the molecule.
mol.import.done: Outcome of an import; {n} = molecules imported, {replaced} = those that replaced one already imported, {kept} = those the user had modified and which stay as they are.
mol.import.errors: Title of the error list of a rejected molecules file; {n} = number of errors.
mol.err.row: Start of an import error row; {riga} = row number in the file (or position of the record in the JSON).
mol.err.more: End of the truncated error list; {n} = errors not shown.
predef.ket.error: Error (alert) if a .ket drawing opened by the system cannot be read; {name} = file name, {detail} = cause (may be empty).
int.lrAll.done: Notice after «Integrate every peak shown» (low resolution); {n} = peaks added, {w} = smoothing window in points (odd), {a} = text of int.lrAll.auto or empty, {v} = valley depth in %, {sn} = minimum S/N, {noise} = trace noise in counts (scientific notation), {split} = how touching peaks are split (pk.split.0 or pk.split.1), {c} = baseline ends lowered onto the trace, {e} = all ends, {below} = total area under the line.
int.lrAll.skip: Tail of the int.lrAll.done notice; {n} = peaks found but not added because they overlap integrations already there.
int.menu.files: Menu entry (next to «Integrate every peak shown»): finds the peaks of the ions of every file shown, groups the ones at the same time and adds them as integrations.
map.sub.note: Visible note under a DAD difference map; {a},{b} = file names, the rest numbers already rounded.
map.sub.short: Short form of the note of a DAD difference in the map legend; hover shows the full note.
map.sub.scale.none: Scale of the reference in a DAD difference: none.
map.sub.scale.used: Scale of the reference in a DAD difference; {name} = how it was chosen, {f} = factor used.
map.sub.scale.max: Name of the max normalization in a DAD difference note.
map.sub.scale.tic: Name of the total normalization in a DAD difference note.
map.sub.scale.fit: Name of the least-squares fit in a DAD difference note.
map.sub.scale.factor: Name of a typed factor in a DAD difference note.
map.sub.w.rt_step_differs: Warning of a DAD difference; steps in minutes.
map.sub.w.nm_step_differs: Warning of a DAD difference; steps in nm.
map.sub.fail: Shown on a DAD map when the difference fails; the plain map is drawn; {file} escaped, {why} escaped reason.
